paper_title: Recent progress in polymer-based infrared photodetectors

knowledge_points.content: The conjugated polymer polythieno[3,4-b]thiophene (PTT) utilizes an electron-withdrawing ester group to stabilize the electron-rich thiophene unit and lower the HOMO level to 1.3 eV, facilitating energy level matching with PCBM for near-infrared detection.
knowledge_points.evidence: the Yang and co-workers research group designed and synthesized a new type of ester-modified low-bandgap (1.3 eV) polymer polythieno[3,4-b]thiophene (PTT)... The presence of the electronwithdrawing ester group in the polymer could stabilize the electron-rich thiophene and reduce its highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) energy level to match the (6,6)-phenyl C61-butyric acid methyl ester (PCBM)

knowledge_points.content: Functionalizing the main chain of semiconducting polymers with modified 3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene (EDOT) as a conjugated side chain can reduce dark current density by two orders of magnitude in polymer photodetectors.
knowledge_points.evidence: Using modified 3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene (EDOT) as a conjugated side chain, they functionalized the main chain of the semiconducting polymer... achieving a two-level reduction in dark current density

knowledge_points.content: Employing transfer-printed conducting polymer (tp-CP) as upper electrodes in organic photodiodes, rather than vacuum-deposited metal, reduces dark current by more than two orders of magnitude by avoiding doping of the organic active layer during deposition.
knowledge_points.evidence: Zhou and co-workers used transferprinted conducting polymer (tp-CP) as the upper electrodes... the photodetector produced a dark current that was more than two orders of magnitude lower than that of a device using a vacuum deposition electrode.

knowledge_points.content: Conjugated polymers PBTT and PBTB exhibit ultra-low bandgaps of approximately 0.8 eV, enabling wide-range light response extending into the infrared region.
knowledge_points.evidence: Huang and co-workers designed and synthesized two kinds of conjugated polymers poly(benzobisthiadiazolebithiophene-tellurophene) (PBTT) and poly(benzobisthiadiazolebithiophene- 4,4' -dioctyloxy[2,2' bithiophene]) (PBTB) with an ultra-low band gap (0.8 eV)

knowledge_points.content: The integration of Er3+-doped upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) into an organic bulk heterojunction (BHJ) allows for the detection of 1.5 μm infrared light by upconverting sub-bandgap photons into visible photons that the organic host can absorb.
knowledge_points.evidence: The photodetector design strategy utilized a solution-processable conjugated polymer/small molecule bulk heterojunction as the host and Er3+ -doped upconversion nanoparticles as the guest... UCNPs could efficiently upconvert λ = 1.5 μm photons to visible photons, and then transfer the energy to the organic BHJ host

knowledge_points.content: A dual-trap mode organic phototransistor using Ag nanoparticles for hole trapping and PC61BM for electron trapping achieved a specific detectivity (D*) of 8.21 x 10^16 Jones and a photoresponsivity of 5.26 x 10^3 A/W.
knowledge_points.evidence: They used metallic Ag nanoparticles and PC61BM as trapping sites for holes/electrons... resulting in low-noise currents and high photoresponsivity (5.26 × 10^3 AW^−1), exhibiting ultra-high detection rates... D*shot = 8.21 × 10^16 Jones.

knowledge_points.content: A bilayer heterostructure (BHS) for phototransistors, utilizing cross-linked PDPP-DTT as a carrier transport layer and a blend of PDPP-DTT:PC61BM as a photosensitive layer, enables efficient exciton separation and fast carrier transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: Liu and co-workers designed a polymer phototransistor with a bilayer heterostructure (BHS), which could ensure efficient exciton separation and fast carrier transport. BHS selected cross-linked poly(N-alkyl diketo-pyrrolo-pyrrole dithienylthieno [3,2-b]thiophene) (PDPP-DTT) as the carrier transport layer... and PC61BM as the photosensitive layer.

knowledge_points.content: The 'Gate Sensing Layer' (GSL) architecture in organic phototransistors involves placing a non-field-effect conjugated polymer (e.g., PEHTTPD-BT) between the gate and the dielectric layer to sense infrared light without interfering with the channel's charge transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: a conjugated polymer without field-effect properties was placed between the gate and the dielectric layer as the NIR sensing layer, called the NIR Gate Sensing Layer (GSL). They used the conjugated polymer... (PEHTTPD-BT) as the gate sensing layer

knowledge_points.content: Hybrid phototransistors based on In2O3 and the n-type polymerizing small-molecular acceptor PTPBT-ET have demonstrated long-term operational stability exceeding 160 days with a specific detectivity of 1.2 x 10^13 Jones at 810 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: successfully prepared air-stable high-performance infrared phototransistors... successfully achieved a high specific detection rate of 1.2 × 10^13 Jones at 810 nm NIR light and a long-term stable performance of more than 160 days

knowledge_points.content: Doping the polymer PolyTPD with the Lewis acid tris(pentafluorophenyl)borane (BCF) extends the short-wave infrared (SWIR) absorption range of the material up to approximately 3200 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: Lee and co-workers realized the doping of polytriarylamine... (PolyTPD) with tris(pentafluorophenyl)borane (BCF), and well-controlled SWIR absorption (up to λ = ~3200 nm) was obtained.

knowledge_points.content: A PTT-based polymer photodiode demonstrates high-speed temporal response with both rise and fall times measured at approximately 100 ns.
knowledge_points.evidence: the prepared photodiode could realize the effective detection of near-infrared light as shown in Fig. 1b with the rise and fall times both around 100 ns

knowledge_points.content: The use of crosslinked PolyTPD as an electron blocking layer in organic photodiodes helps achieve ultra-low dark current densities as low as 0.2 nA/cm².
knowledge_points.evidence: Their innovative use of crosslinked poly (N, N' - bis-4-butylphenyl- · N N' -bisphenyl)benzidine (PolyTPD) as an electron blocking layer provided effective blocking of electron injection... achieving an ultra-low dark current density of 0.2 nA cm^−2
